spiderLair._comment: Mother of All Spiders: tile 77 right-click in A Secluded Herb starts the Old Widow battle in Sewers (same room CustomBattles uses for Knarknaknork/Ekatrix/Jakundaf — activationCheck flags keep them from colliding). tileMutations applied via applySpiderLairTileMutations() in Quests.js, same mechanism as alDeeRookieGuard.tileMutations.

taintedSouls._comment: Eclipse cauldron tiles accept the Stuffed Toad and spawn a teleporter (sprite 1959) on tile 81. Entering the portal starts the Ekatrix battle in Sewers until she is defeated.

alDeeRookieGuard._comment: The Rookie Guard: portal on tile 109 in Katana Quest teleports into the Knarknaknork battle in Sewers (same room CustomBattles uses for Ekatrix — activationCheck flags keep them from colliding).

hellgateTreasureRoom._comment: Elathriel's Hellgate Part 1: chat-triggered teleport (not a portal tile) into the Fire Elemental battle in Sewers (same room CustomBattles reuses for Knarknaknork/Ekatrix/Spider Lair — activationCheck flags keep them from colliding).

mornenion._comment: Ab'Dendriel Hive (roomId abwasp) decor mutations for the Mornenion battle, applied tile-by-tile via applyMornenionTileMutations() in Quests.js — same mechanism as alDeeRookieGuard.tileMutations for Sewers.

hellgateLibrary._comment: Elathriel's Hellgate Library: chat-triggered teleport into the Sewers (same room CustomBattles reuses for Hellgate Part 1 / Ekatrix / Spider Lair). The battle only spawns once the Wrinkled Bonelord takes the book — see startHellgateLibraryBattle() in Quests.js.

isleOfSolitude._comment: King Tibianus easter egg: ask him about 'Isle of Solitude' or 'GM Island' to teleport into the Sewers (rkswrs) re-skinned as the isle. Pure walk-around, no mission, no battle. Right-click the teleporter on tile 37 to return. See enterIsleOfSolitude() in Quests.js.

draconiaTower._comment: Elathriel’s Draconia Tower: chat-triggered teleport into the Sewers (same room CustomBattles reuses for Hellgate Part 1 / Library / Ekatrix / Spider Lair) re-skinned as a dragon cemetery. The battle spawns on entry; on victory the Dragon Lord and Dragon despawn and An Old Dragonlord places as a board NPC on tile 80 — see enterDraconiaTower() in Quests.js.

draconiaQuest._comment: Elathriel’s Draconia Quest: the final step after Draconia Tower. Chat-triggered teleport into the Sewers (re-skinned) for one last battle; on victory the player uses the Dragonfetish to return to Hedge Maze (item consumed), then speaks to Elathriel to close the quest and receive the Key to Magic (Book). See enterDraconiaQuest() in Quests.js.

realmOfDreams._comment: Realm of Dreams quest (prep for a future quest that actually enters it). Tesha reads the Key to Magic (Book), then sends the player down into the Northern Dragon Lair / dragon graveyard to put out the fire guarding the way to the Realm of Dreams. Chat-triggered teleport into the Sewers (re-skinned as the burning dragon lair) for a Fire Elemental battle. The book is consumed on victory. The player then returns to Darama Oasis and speaks to Tesha, who hands over a Mintwallin Prison Key found among the bones (King Tibianus has a hint line about it; a later quest follows up). See enterRealmOfDreams() in Quests.js.

mintwallinPrison._comment: Visiting Mintwallin (the Mad Mage), Part 1. King Tibianus explains the Mad Mage and grants passage into the Sewers (rkswrs) re-skinned as the prison beneath Mintwallin. Pure walk-around, no battle. A Prisoner stands on tile 81 as a keyword Board NPC. Right-click the teleporter on tile 84 to return. See enterMintwallinPrison() in Quests.js.

madMageRoom._comment: Mad Mage Room, Part 2 of the Mad Mage Room quest (mission id visiting_mintwallin). Once A Prisoner's riddle is solved, the tile-84 teleporter in the Mintwallin prison takes the player here instead of home — the Sewers re-skinned as the Mad Mage's monster-guarded room, a battle. On victory the player is sent back where they came from and hails King Tibianus to close the mission. See enterMadMageRoom() in Quests.js.
